summary: Sonoma Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K on October 6, 2026, disclosing a Section 382 rights agreement (a US tax-benefit poison pill, the US analogue of a takeover-protection rights plan) with Computershare as rights agent, replacing an expiring 2016 plan. One preferred stock purchase right is distributed per common share outstanding on the October 13, 2026 record date; each right buys 1/1,000 of a Series B Preferred share at $10.00, subject to adjustment. The board adopted an Amended and Restated Certificate of Designation effective the same day, citing NOL protection rather than a live bid. Watch for activist 13D accumulations and pill-trigger mechanics.
